headline: Chest-high ESE on the prime angle, groomed early — best in the morning.
today: Prime ESE direction and size to 3.5ft total, with cross-off NNW at dawn giving you the cleanest window before wind goes straight cross N. Short period keeps it from being all-time, but there's push and shape early. Fish or shortboard, hit it at first light around the 8:39a low before it turns to sideways mush. Solid morning for the inlet.

daysToWatch.note: Marginal angle but W-WSW goes offshore through the afternoon and evening — could clean up into a fun small session if the swell cooperates.
Offshore W all day and steady SSE swell to 2ft — clean fun-size window if you want a quiet weekday go.
